name: Christmas PFP Maker
tagline: Free Christmas profile picture maker with Santa hats and frames, plus an optional AI Christmas photo generator.
description:
Christmas PFP Maker is a free Christmas profile picture maker with an AI Christmas photo generator. Add a Santa hat, elf hat or antlers plus a wreath, candy cane or lights frame to your photo, then download a square PNG for Discord, X, Instagram or TikTok. No sign-up and no watermark, and your photo never leaves your device.

Watch out: the free path adds a hat or frame on your device and does not ask you to sign up. A separate AI photo path is labeled 2 free credits and makes a new scene. The page opened on 2026-11-14 is a profile-picture maker. It does not address children.
